title: Phase 2: Benchmark reference table + CPU-name matching/override system + unmatched-CPU reporting
description: Rollup for Phase 2 (docs/plan/plan.md Implementation Phases) -- not itself a single actionable task. Delivers: benchmark-map/ + CPU-name matching/alias/override logic + unmatched-CPU reporting. See child tasks for the actual work.

title: Component: benchmark-map/ -- CPU-name to benchmark-score reference table
description: Rollup/reference bead for the benchmark-map/ component. Not itself an actionable single task. See child task.

title: Decide pipeline implementation language/runtime
description: Open Question in docs/plan/plan.md, tagged 'Resolve before Phase 1' -- the fetcher (Phase 1's deliverable) has to be written in something. Affects which Parquet-writer library is available later (Format Verification note, Phase 3). No code dependency -- a decision, not implementation work.

title: Provision R2 bucket + API token (OpenBao/ExternalSecret)
description: Create the Cloudflare R2 bucket; generate a bucket-scoped API token; store as an OpenBao-backed ExternalSecret matching existing patterns. Pure infra, no code dependency -- can be done anytime.

title: Component: unmatched-cpus.json -- unmatched-CPU report
description: Rollup/reference bead for the unmatched-cpus.json component -- generation (Phase 2) + R2 publishing (Phase 4). Not itself an actionable single task. See child tasks.

title: Build benchmark-map/ reference table + CPU-name matching/alias/override logic
description: Raw CPU string -> normalized model name -> PassMark ID via an alias table + manual override list. Tested against the CPU-matching fixture set (Testing Strategy), including near-miss adversarial pairs (Risk Register R1's only real defense) and intentionally-unmatchable strings -> benchmark_matched = false.

title: User-selectable primary sort axis (RAM/disk-first mode)
description: Let RAM- or storage-heavy buyers (NAS, in-memory cache workloads) promote price_per_gb_ram or price_per_tb_disk to the primary sort instead of price_per_benchmark_point_multi. Direct extension of ADR-3's 'separate metrics, user decides priority' philosophy -- benchmark-value stays the documented default, this is opt-in. From idea-gen run 2026-08-02, ledger finalist #2. v1.1 tier.

title: Genesis: hetzner-auction-dashboard Implementation
description:
## Genesis Bead
Tied to plan: docs/plan/plan.md

## Overview
Client-side dashboard for Hetzner server auction listings. A pipeline joins CPU benchmark scores onto listings and publishes a Parquet file (plus a companion unmatched-CPU report) to Cloudflare R2 via a temp-key-then-swap lifecycle; a static browser frontend on Cloudflare Pages using DuckDB-WASM does search/filter/sort only. The benchmark join itself is the core differentiator.

## Progress
- [ ] Phase 1: Pipeline -- fetch Hetzner auction data, define raw schema
- [ ] Phase 2: Benchmark reference table + CPU-name matching/override system + unmatched-CPU reporting
- [ ] Phase 3: Cost-metric computation + Parquet writer
- [ ] Phase 4: R2 bucket + API token + refresh-loop Deployment via declarative-config
- [ ] Phase 5: Client dashboard -- DuckDB-WASM wiring + search/filter UI
- [ ] Phase 6: Deploy pipeline to a Rackspace Spot cluster via GitOps; wire up Cloudflare Pages for web/

v1.1 additions (had-4ct, had-1vp, had-33l, had-39b, had-2ua) and v2/Future Candidates are tracked separately and do not block this genesis bead -- they are explicitly non-blocking per the plan.

title: Build the Parquet writer + DuckDB-WASM conformance test
description: Serialize computed listing records to a single denormalized Parquet file. Round-trip conformance test: DuckDB-WASM must actually load and query the writer's output via httpfs range requests before Phase 3 is considered complete (Testing Strategy) -- the one hand-off point where 'should work in theory' isn't good enough.

title: Phase 1: Pipeline -- fetch Hetzner auction data, define raw schema
description:
Delivers: a working fetcher against Hetzner's live auction feed and a defined raw schema for what a listing looks like before any enrichment.

Completion criteria:
- Fetcher successfully retrieves and parses a real auction response end-to-end
- Raw schema fields match Data Models' pre-enrichment columns (listing_id, cpu_raw, ram_gb, disks, price_base, etc.)
- A malformed/empty response is handled without crashing (see Edge Case Catalog EC-1/EC-2)

See docs/plan/plan.md Implementation Phases.

title: Saved/named filter presets (URL-encoded)
description: Serialize current filter state into URL query params on every filter change, read back on page load -- bookmarkable, no sharing required, pure self-bookmarking for the one real user. From idea-gen run 2026-08-02, ledger finalist #5. v1.1 tier -- user explicitly deprioritized this behind core v1 functionality, hence Low priority.

title: Deploy pipeline to production Rackspace Spot cluster
description: Resolve Open Questions' cluster choice, sync via GitOps, verify 3 consecutive scheduled runs without manual intervention.

title: Diff view between two Parquet snapshots
description: Client-side (IndexedDB) comparison of 'what changed since I last looked' -- cache the previous fetched snapshot and diff row-by-config-signature against the current one. Gets partial price-history value weeks before v2's full historical-stats architecture ships, with zero pipeline changes. From idea-gen run 2026-08-02, ledger finalist #3. v1.1 tier.

title: Cross-link listings to Hetzner's own Cloud catalog pricing
description: Show 'X% cheaper than the equivalent still-selling Hetzner Cloud instance' on each listing. Requires a small, separately hand-maintained lookup table mapping common CPU/RAM/disk tiers to their nearest Hetzner Cloud SKU price (catalog pricing changes rarely, unlike the 10-min auction feed, so maintenance burden is low). From idea-gen run 2026-08-02, ledger finalist #4. v1.1 tier -- note in Components as a small new lookup artifact, distinct from benchmark-map/.

comments.author: cli
comments.text: Also represents the 6th item in plan.md's Components section: 'Hetzner Cloud catalog price lookup (v1.1)'. Explicitly v1.1-tier and non-blocking per the plan, so this bead is not wired as a blocker of the genesis bead (had-2h2) the way the 5 core components and 6 phases are.

title: Build unmatched-CPU report generator (unmatched-cpus.json)
description: For every listing where matching failed, collect cpu_raw + affected-listing count into the unmatched-cpus.json shape (Benchmark Strategy). Overwritten each run, not accumulated across runs.

title: Verify agentation's CDN ESM build + mount isolated React root
description: Confirm agentation actually publishes a CDN-consumable ESM build (ADR-5's invalidation trigger -- unverified as of this writing; if it doesn't, fall back to ADR-5's rejected alternatives). Mount via a small React 18 root, isolated from the dashboard's own state -- must remain removable with zero effect on filters/sorts/data loading. Independent of the dashboard's own data wiring -- can be done anytime.

title: Starter configs (3-5 pre-built example searches)
description: Pre-built example searches (e.g. Budget web server, Home NAS, Game server) as one-click filter presets, for a first-time visitor who doesn't want to configure filters from scratch. From idea-gen run 2026-08-02, ledger finalist #1 (split). v1.1 tier.

title: Phase 4: R2 bucket + API token + refresh-loop Deployment via declarative-config
description: Rollup for Phase 4 -- not itself a single actionable task. Delivers: a running, GitOps-managed pipeline Deployment publishing both artifacts to R2 every 10 minutes via the full temp-key-then-swap lifecycle. See child tasks.

title: Build the Argo Workflow that deploys web/ to Cloudflare Pages
description: New WorkflowTemplate in jedarden/declarative-config (k8s/iad-ci/argo-workflows/), modeled on jedarden.com's website-build: runs 'wrangler pages deploy' (Direct Upload) against web/'s built artifacts -- never Cloudflare's own git-integration auto-build (ADR-6). Wire an Argo Events webhook trigger on push (manual submission as the fallback, matching jedarden.com's pattern). Pure devops/pipeline-definition work, independent of the dashboard's own feature code -- no blockers.

title: Wire DuckDB-WASM (load Parquet via httpfs, run queries)
description: Load the published Parquet file via DuckDB-WASM's httpfs with range requests; confirm arbitrary WHERE/ORDER BY queries work against it client-side.

title: Wrap pipeline logic in a 10-minute refresh loop
description: Application code: wrap the already-built fetch -> match -> compute -> write -> publish pipeline in a loop that runs every 10 minutes. Pure app-code, no infra/YAML.

title: Phase 5: Client dashboard -- DuckDB-WASM wiring + search/filter UI
description: Rollup for Phase 5 -- not itself a single actionable task. Delivers: the static web/ site (DuckDB-WASM wiring + filter/sort UI + isolated Agentation root). See child tasks.

title: Build the publish lifecycle (temp-key-then-swap for both artifacts)
description: Write to a temp R2 key, verify (valid Parquet or JSON per artifact), atomic promote (copy-then-delete-old for the reused live keys), Cache-Control: max-age=60 header (ADR-4), abort-without-touching-live-key on any failure. Covers both the Parquet snapshot and unmatched-cpus.json. Test: a forced mid-run failure leaves both live R2 keys' hashes unchanged.

title: Component: web/ -- static frontend (DuckDB-WASM + filter/search UI)
description: Rollup/reference bead for the web/ component -- DuckDB-WASM wiring, filter/sort UI, and the isolated Agentation root (all Phase 5). Not itself an actionable single task. See child tasks.

title: Component: pipeline/ -- fetcher, CPU benchmark join, cost-metric computation, Parquet writer
description: Rollup/reference bead for the pipeline/ component (docs/plan/plan.md Components) -- spans Phases 1,2,3,4. Not itself an actionable single task; does not block the genesis bead directly since its children already gate genesis via their Phase-rollup parents. See child tasks.

title: Phase 6: Deploy pipeline to a Rackspace Spot cluster via GitOps; wire up Cloudflare Pages for web/
description: Rollup for Phase 6 -- not itself a single actionable task. Delivers: both halves live in production. See child tasks.

title: Component: Parquet output -- published to Cloudflare R2
description: Rollup/reference bead for the Parquet-output component -- the writer (Phase 3) + R2 publishing (Phase 4). Not itself an actionable single task. See child tasks.

title: Implement Graceful Degradation error states
description: Distinct failure-mode concern (its own plan section + Acceptance Scenario 3), not a feature: when the Parquet fetch/DuckDB-WASM load fails in-browser, show an explicit error state naming the likely cause -- never a blank page or silent hang.

title: One-click best-deal-now button
description: A single button returning one defensible top-value listing (highest price_per_benchmark_point_multi among benchmark_matched=true listings). Independent of starter configs -- separable feature, same finalist origin. From idea-gen run 2026-08-02, ledger finalist #1 (split). v1.1 tier.

title: Containerize pipeline + write GitOps Deployment manifest
description: Dockerfile for the pipeline; k8s Deployment manifest (replicas: 1 -- house rule: no Job/CronJob) living in jedarden/declarative-config, synced by ArgoCD -- never a live kubectl mutation.

title: Phase 3: Cost-metric computation + Parquet writer
description: Rollup for Phase 3 -- not itself a single actionable task. Delivers: computed cost metrics + a Parquet writer verified against DuckDB-WASM. See child tasks.

title: Build filter/sort UI (Client Dashboard Scope v1)
description: All v1 filters (price, RAM, disk type/size, uplink speed, CPU model, location/datacenter, ECC, benchmark-matched-only toggle), all sorts including the 4 per-resource metrics independently, default sort price_per_benchmark_point_multi ascending NULLS FIRST, staleness indicator.

title: Compute the 4 derived cost metrics
description: price_effective_monthly (= price_base + price_setup_fee, full-value non-amortized), price_per_benchmark_point_single, price_per_benchmark_point_multi, price_per_gb_ram, price_per_tb_disk. NULL benchmark-point metrics when benchmark_matched = false, never a divide-by-zero or fallback estimate. Tested against a fixture set including zero and non-zero setup fee, and one unmatched listing.
